## About
Rudy's Auto Body & Paint is located in East Orlando on Old Cheney Hwy. The shop handles collision repair, body repair, frame repair, paint jobs and paint matching to factory finish, using what the site calls "the most up-to-date equipment available."
The body department runs a frame machine, laser measuring systems, compression resistance welders, MIG welders and plasma cutters. The paint department uses a Blowtherm downdraft bake booth, a UV cure prime system and a computerized mixing system.
Mark Sawyers owns the facility and Obed Santiago manages the collision center. Customers and insurers can check repair status online through the RADAR system. Rated 4.3 on Google from 103 reviews.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Collision work handled by the collision center team.
- Body Repair: Repair of damaged body panels such as doors and fenders.
- Frame Repair: Frame work done on a frame machine with laser measuring systems.
- Auto Paint Jobs: Full paint jobs for cars with failing or damaged paint, done in a downdraft bake booth.
- Paint Matching to Factory Finish: Color matched to the original finish using a computerized mixing system and a full North America, Asia and European color alternates system.
- Towing & Storage: Towing and storage for vehicles coming in for repair.

## FAQ
Q: Can I check on my car while it's being repaired?
A: Yes. The RADAR online system lets customers and insurers verify the status of the work on their vehicles.

Q: Do you work with insurers?
A: Yes. The shop's commitment covers both the vehicle owner and insurers, and insurers can check on their clients' cars through RADAR.

Q: Will the new paint match the rest of the car?
A: Matching to factory finish is one of the listed services. One fleet customer said the repainted areas looked OEM and blended in.

Q: How do I find the entrance?
A: One customer said the entrance is easy to miss on Old Cheney Hwy, so keep driving all the way through.
